node.title: Faros AI — offering root
node.summary: Faros V observes AI work from tickets to outcomes to spend, optimizes context, and governs with provenance — one platform spanning the whole chain.
node.interview_question: In one sentence, what is Faros — and why isn't it just another FinOps or DevEx dashboard?

competitor.name: Harness
competitor.positioning: Harness pitches one end-to-end software-delivery platform too, and its AI DLC Insights (May 2026) sells the same 'token spend → shipped software' story — the closest whole-platform analog.
